title: [Dev] Timestamps are showing as HH:mm PM/AM 12 hour format instead of 24 hour format in english
symptom: In the Dev version, timestamps are showing in 12-hour AM/PM format instead of 24-hour format, whereas in Master 3.3 they are 24-hour. The issue is observed in English locale.
cause: A recent change caused the issue; the format is taken from system setting, but strings are not consistent in format, leading to mixed formats in English.
fix: The change was reverted by MilosKozak via commit d8fb620a18c0339f07f8526463d1e447b2803926.
